title: Safe segment of length zero
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape machine, $F$ a set of states, $P$ a predicate on work-tape head positions, and $a$ a configuration. If the state of $a$ is outside $F$ and $P$ holds at its work-tape head-position vector, then there is a safe segment from $a$ to itself of length zero.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ holds at the work-tape head-position vector of $a$
